cohort: Singleton newborn infants delivered at term after onset of labor in Sweden from 1999 to 2010 (VE group: n=87,150, CS group: n=75,216, Spontaneous vaginal delivery group: n=851,347)
finding: Vacuum assisted delivery is associated with an increased risk for neonatal intracranial hemorrhages.
mod_finding: Vacuum assisted delivery is associated with an increased risk for neonatal intracranial hemorrhages, particularly in short women and large infants.
